questions.stem: Contoso's IT team is starting a cloud migration, and the manager asks them to document the company's digital estate first. What should the digital estate include?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的 IT 团队正在启动云迁移，经理要求他们先把公司的数字资产（digital estate）整理清楚。数字资产应该包括什么？
options: Only the servers that will move to Azure first
All servers, applications, data, and the connections between them
Only the software licenses and support contracts the company owns
The Azure subscriptions and resource groups already created
questions.explain: The digital estate is everything IT runs today, because it covers all servers, applications, data, and how they connect, not just the first servers to move.
questions.zhExplain: 数字资产是 IT 当前运行的全部内容，因为它涵盖所有服务器、应用、数据以及它们之间的连接，而不只是最先迁移的服务器。

questions.stem: Fabrikam wants to move to Azure next month, but its only inventory is a list of server roles and OS versions. Why must the team understand the full digital estate before planning?
questions.zhStem: Fabrikam 想在下个月迁移到 Azure，但它唯一的清单只列出了服务器角色和操作系统版本。为什么团队在制定计划前必须了解完整的数字资产？
options: Azure refuses to create VMs until an inventory file is uploaded
Azure Migrate can only replicate servers listed in a spreadsheet
Sizing, cost, and migration order depend on what exists and how it connects
Licensing rules require a signed inventory before any migration
questions.explain: The team must know the full estate first, because VM sizing, cost, and migration order all depend on what exists and how it connects.
questions.zhExplain: 团队必须先了解完整的数字资产，因为虚拟机规格、成本和迁移顺序都取决于有哪些资源以及它们如何连接。

questions.stem: Contoso moves its application server to Azure without any discovery or assessment, and the database it uses stays on-premises. What is the most likely result?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 在没有做任何发现和评估的情况下把应用服务器迁到了 Azure，而它使用的数据库仍留在本地。最可能出现什么结果？
options: Azure automatically moves the database along with the app server
Nothing, because Azure VMs detect and fix missing dependencies
The migration is blocked until the database server is deleted
The app fails or slows down because a missed dependency was split
questions.explain: The app fails or slows down, because skipping discovery missed the dependency between the app server and its database.
questions.zhExplain: 应用会出错或变慢，因为跳过发现步骤漏掉了应用服务器与数据库之间的依赖关系。

questions.stem: Contoso runs its servers as VMware VMs managed by vCenter and wants to discover them without installing anything on each VM. What is the correct approach?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的服务器是由 vCenter 管理的 VMware 虚拟机，团队希望在不往每台虚拟机上安装任何东西的情况下发现它们。正确的做法是什么？
options: Deploy the Azure Migrate appliance on vCenter and collect data for about 30 days
Install a discovery agent on each VM and collect data for one hour
Export a user list from Active Directory and import it as performance data
Replicate every VM to Azure first, then measure usage there
questions.explain: Deploying the Azure Migrate appliance on vCenter is correct, because it discovers VMs agentlessly through vCenter and about 30 days of data captures peak usage.
questions.zhExplain: 在 vCenter 上部署 Azure Migrate 设备是正确的，因为它通过 vCenter 无代理地发现虚拟机，收集约 30 天的数据能捕捉到使用高峰。

questions.stem: A Contoso administrator has deployed the Azure Migrate appliance from an OVA template on vCenter. How does the appliance get each VM's configuration and performance data?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一位管理员已用 OVA 模板在 vCenter 上部署了 Azure Migrate 设备。该设备如何获取每台虚拟机的配置和性能数据？
options: It installs an agent on each VM through Remote Desktop
It needs a domain admin account with write access to every VM
It connects to vCenter Server with a read-only account over port 443
It copies VM disk files to Azure Storage and scans them there
questions.explain: The appliance uses a read-only vCenter account over port 443, because it reads VM configuration and performance through the vSphere APIs without installing anything on the servers.
questions.zhExplain: 设备通过 443 端口使用只读的 vCenter 账户，因为它通过 vSphere API 读取虚拟机配置和性能，无需在服务器上安装任何东西。

questions.stem: Contoso's discovery has been running in Azure Migrate for two weeks. Which set of information is it collecting about each server?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已经在 Azure Migrate 中运行发现两周了。它正在收集每台服务器的哪一组信息？
options: Only server names and IP addresses
Configuration, performance, installed software, and server dependencies
Only the monthly Azure cost for each server
Application source code and its build history
questions.explain: Discovery collects configuration, performance, software, and dependencies, because assessment later needs all of these facts to judge readiness, size, and cost.
questions.zhExplain: 发现会收集配置、性能、软件和依赖关系，因为后续评估需要这些事实来判断就绪度、规格和成本。

questions.stem: A new analyst at Contoso says discovery and assessment are the same step in Azure Migrate. Which statement correctly separates them?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一位新分析师说，在 Azure Migrate 中发现和评估是同一个步骤。哪种说法正确区分了二者？
options: Discovery estimates cost; assessment lists which servers exist
Discovery runs in Azure; assessment runs only on-premises
Discovery moves servers; assessment tests them after the move
Discovery collects server facts; assessment uses them to judge readiness, size, and cost
questions.explain: Discovery gathers facts and assessment judges them, because assessment turns the collected data into readiness, VM size, and monthly cost.
questions.zhExplain: 发现负责收集事实，评估负责判断，因为评估把收集到的数据转化为就绪度、虚拟机规格和月度成本。

questions.stem: Contoso assumes that every server depends on the domain controller DC-01, but nobody has proof. How can the team confirm this assumption?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 假设每台服务器都依赖域控制器 DC-01，但没有人能证明。团队如何确认这一假设？
options: Check each server's OS version in the vCenter inventory
Shut down DC-01 in production and see what breaks
Run dependency analysis and look for connections to DC-01 on ports 88, 389, or 53
Read the VM size recommendation in the assessment report
questions.explain: Dependency analysis confirms it, because it shows each server's TCP connections with process and port, such as Kerberos, LDAP, or DNS traffic to DC-01.
questions.zhExplain: 依赖关系分析可以确认这一点，因为它会显示每台服务器的 TCP 连接及其进程和端口，例如发往 DC-01 的 Kerberos、LDAP 或 DNS 流量。

questions.stem: A Contoso team plans to migrate its servers one at a time in any order that fits the schedule. Why should they run dependency analysis first?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的一个团队计划按日程方便的任意顺序逐台迁移服务器。为什么他们应该先做依赖关系分析？
options: So servers that depend on each other move together and nothing is cut off
So Azure can choose a cheaper region for each server
So the team can skip the readiness assessment
So each server can be migrated in a separate month
questions.explain: Dependency analysis comes first, because servers that depend on each other must move together so none is left cut off from what it needs.
questions.zhExplain: 应先做依赖关系分析，因为相互依赖的服务器必须一起迁移，才不会有服务器与所需资源断开。

questions.stem: Contoso has WEB-01, APP-01, and DB-01 (APP-01 connects to DB-01), plus DC-01 and FILE-01, which serve all servers. Which servers belong in the same migration group?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 有 WEB-01、APP-01 和 DB-01（APP-01 连接 DB-01），还有为所有服务器提供服务的 DC-01 和 FILE-01。哪些服务器应放在同一个迁移组中？
options: All five servers, because they share the same domain
WEB-01, APP-01, and DB-01, because they form one application
APP-01 and FILE-01, because both run Windows Server
DB-01 and DC-01, because both are business-critical
questions.explain: WEB-01, APP-01, and DB-01 form one group, because they are one application and splitting them would send database traffic over the VPN.
questions.zhExplain: WEB-01、APP-01 和 DB-01 构成一组，因为它们是同一个应用，拆开迁移会让数据库流量走 VPN。

questions.stem: Contoso's FILE-01 runs Windows Server 2012 R2, whose Extended Security Updates end in October 2026. How should its Azure readiness be classified?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的 FILE-01 运行 Windows Server 2012 R2，其扩展安全更新将于 2026 年 10 月结束。它的 Azure 就绪度应如何分类？
options: Ready, because Azure VMs can run any Windows version
Insufficient Information, because the file share sizes are unknown
Conditionally Ready, because it only needs a DNS change
Not Ready, because the OS will no longer get security patches
questions.explain: FILE-01 is Not Ready, because an out-of-support OS with no security patches is a blocker that needs an OS upgrade during migration.
questions.zhExplain: FILE-01 属于未就绪（Not Ready），因为不再获得安全补丁的过期操作系统是一个阻碍因素，需要在迁移时升级操作系统。

questions.stem: Contoso's Azure Migrate assessment shows a recommended VM size and a monthly cost for each server. Where do these numbers come from?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的 Azure Migrate 评估为每台服务器给出了推荐的虚拟机规格和月度成本。这些数字来自哪里？
options: Collected configuration and performance data, priced for the chosen region and options
A fixed global price list that ignores the region
The largest VM size available, chosen to be safe
Manual estimates typed in by the server owners
questions.explain: The numbers come from collected data, because the assessment maps each server's configuration and performance to a VM size and disk type and prices them for the chosen region and pricing options.
questions.zhExplain: 这些数字来自收集的数据，因为评估会把每台服务器的配置和性能映射到虚拟机规格和磁盘类型，并按所选区域和定价选项计价。

questions.stem: Contoso's on-premises servers each have 16 vCPUs but use only about 10 percent of their CPU. Which sizing option avoids paying for unused capacity in Azure?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的每台本地服务器都有 16 个 vCPU，但 CPU 使用率只有约 10%。哪种规格选项可以避免在 Azure 中为闲置容量付费？
options: As-is sizing, because it copies the current specs exactly
As-is sizing, because it is based on peak usage data
Performance-based sizing, because it uses actual usage over time
Performance-based sizing, because it always picks the smallest VM
questions.explain: Performance-based sizing avoids waste, because it right-sizes VMs from actual CPU, memory, and disk usage instead of copying on-premises specs.
questions.zhExplain: 基于性能的规格可以避免浪费，因为它根据实际的 CPU、内存和磁盘使用情况确定合适的虚拟机规格，而不是照搬本地配置。

questions.stem: Contoso already owns Windows Server licenses with Software Assurance and will run its VMs for three years. Which choices lower the estimated Azure cost?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 已拥有带软件保障的 Windows Server 许可证，并将运行虚拟机三年。哪些选择可以降低 Azure 的估算成本？
options: Pay-as-you-go licensing and Premium SSD for every disk
Azure Hybrid Benefit and reserved instances
As-is sizing and pay-as-you-go pricing
Larger VM sizes and shorter commitments
questions.explain: Azure Hybrid Benefit and reserved instances lower the cost, because the first reuses existing licenses and the second gives a discount for a long-term commitment.
questions.zhExplain: Azure Hybrid Benefit 和预留实例可以降低成本，因为前者复用现有许可证，后者通过长期承诺获得折扣。

questions.stem: Contoso has one mission-critical database server and several low-risk servers to migrate. Following risk-based prioritization, when should the database server move?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 有一台关键任务数据库服务器和若干台低风险服务器需要迁移。按照基于风险的优先级排序，数据库服务器应在何时迁移？
options: First, because the most important server should move earliest
Alone on a weekend, before any dependency analysis
At any time, because risk does not affect migration order
Last, after the process is proven on less critical servers
questions.explain: The database server should move last, because moving from lowest to highest risk proves the process on less critical servers first.
questions.zhExplain: 数据库服务器应最后迁移，因为按从低到高的风险顺序迁移，可以先在不太关键的服务器上验证流程。

questions.stem: Contoso's plan is: build a new domain controller in Azure, move FILE-01, move the WEB/APP/DB group, then retire DC-01. Why does the new domain controller come first?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 的计划是：先在 Azure 中建一台新的域控制器，再迁移 FILE-01，然后迁移 WEB/APP/DB 组，最后停用 DC-01。为什么新的域控制器要排在第一步？
options: Every other server needs it for sign-in and DNS
It is the largest server and takes the longest to copy
Azure requires a domain controller before any VM can be created
It has the most security blockers to fix
questions.explain: The new domain controller goes first, because every other server depends on it for sign-in and DNS once it runs in Azure.
questions.zhExplain: 新的域控制器排在第一步，因为其他所有服务器在 Azure 中运行时都依赖它来登录和解析 DNS。

questions.stem: During cutover, Contoso finds that APP-01 in Azure cannot reach DB-01, and the fix will not fit in the maintenance window. What should the team do?
questions.zhStem: 在切换过程中，Contoso 发现 Azure 中的 APP-01 无法连接 DB-01，而修复工作在维护窗口内无法完成。团队应该怎么做？
options: Delete the original servers so users must use Azure
Keep Azure live and fix the problem next week
Point DNS back on-premises, restart the original servers, and stop the Azure VMs
Rebuild DB-01 from scratch in a different Azure region
questions.explain: The team should roll back, because a failed check that cannot be fixed in the window is the trigger, and the original servers were shut down, not deleted.
questions.zhExplain: 团队应该回滚，因为无法在维护窗口内修复的检查失败就是回滚的触发条件，而原服务器只是关机而没有删除。

questions.stem: Contoso wants to check that a replicated server boots and its application works in Azure, without affecting any users. What should the team use?
questions.zhStem: Contoso 想确认一台已复制的服务器能在 Azure 中启动且其应用正常运行，同时不影响任何用户。团队应该使用什么？
options: A full migration with the original server shut down
An Azure Migrate test migration into an isolated Azure network
A test migration into the production virtual network
Dependency analysis on the replicated server
questions.explain: A test migration into an isolated network is correct, because it creates a copy while the original keeps running, so users and dependent systems are not affected.
questions.zhExplain: 迁移到隔离网络的测试迁移是正确的，因为它在原服务器继续运行的同时创建一个副本，用户和依赖系统都不受影响。
